place_fields.micro_region: Kukkujadka, Amaramudnoor, Sullia taluk, Dakshina Kannada, Karnataka
place_fields.vibe: Quiet, forested hidden waterfall with a village-road approach
place_fields.summary: A roughly 50-foot waterfall near Kukkujadka, about 14 km from Sullia. It is surrounded by dense greenery and has a short approach from Kukkujadka.
place_fields.best_time: Monsoon and the wetter months, when the waterfall's flow increases; it retains some flow year-round.

planning_attributes.description: Chamadka Falls is a natural waterfall near Kukkujadka in Sullia taluk. Bangalore Mirror reports a 2 km walk from Kukkujadka or access by private vehicle, while another report gives the waterfall height as about 50 feet.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Reach Kukkujadka, about 14 km from Sullia; from there the falls are described as roughly a 2 km walk, with private-vehicle access also reported.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The area is surrounded by dense forest. Take extra care on wet ground during the monsoon and avoid climbing directly on the waterfall or slippery rocks.
planning_attributes.notes: The waterfall is also commonly listed simply as Chamadka Falls.

place_fields.micro_region: Paladka, near Moodbidri, Dakshina Kannada, Karnataka
place_fields.vibe: Quiet, lightly visited, forested waterfall with a short trek
place_fields.summary: A small, scenic waterfall also known as Nagundi, Gundyadka or Yerugundi Falls near Moodbidri. The approach includes a short trek and can be more difficult on the Belman route, especially in muddy conditions.
place_fields.best_time: Post-monsoon, especially July to November, when the falls have stronger flow.

planning_attributes.description: Gundiadka Falls, also called Nagundi or Gundyadka Falls, is a lesser-known waterfall near Moodbidri. Sources describe a roughly half-kilometre approach alongside the river, with viewpoints and small bridges near the falls.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The Mudbidri route is described as the smoother approach; the Belman route has more uneven and potentially muddy sections. The final approach includes an approximately half-kilometre trek.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Wet rocks can be slippery, and sources note that there are no lifeguards or immediate assistance. Use caution around the water and during the monsoon.
planning_attributes.local_name_variants: Nagundi Falls; Gundyadka Falls; Yerugundi Falls; Eru Gundi Falls
planning_attributes.notes: The falls are in the Paladka area and are relatively obscure compared with major Karnataka waterfalls.

place_fields.vibe: Large, green, family-oriented eco-education and cultural tourism complex
place_fields.summary: Pilikula Nisargadhama is a large integrated eco-education and tourism destination near Mangaluru, combining natural spaces with attractions such as a biological park, lake and gardens, heritage village, science facilities and other visitor amenities.
place_fields.best_time: Morning is a good fit for nature-focused visits; the site also has a documented morning nature-walk program starting at 6:00 AM. Individual attractions have their own operating hours.

planning_attributes.description: Pilikula Nisargadhama is an eco-education and tourism development project promoted by the Dakshina Kannada district administration. The biological park describes the wider site as an integrated theme park along the Gurupura river, with multiple cultural and scientific attractions.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The site was developed as a district-level eco-education and tourism project and includes facilities for natural, scientific and cultural interpretation.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Karnataka Tourism places Pilikula about 10 km from Mangalore and says it is accessible by road via Mudushedde village. The biological park lists the Mudushedde post address in Mangaluru.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: The Pilikula heritage village is open all days except Monday, 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM; individual attractions within the wider complex can have separate schedules.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Follow the rules and operating hours of the individual attractions. Visitor movement can cover a large area, so allow sufficient time and use the site's available internal transport where appropriate.
planning_attributes.local_name_variants: Pilikula Nisarga Dhama; Dr. Shivarama Karantha Pilikula Nisargadhama
planning_attributes.notes: The wider Pilikula complex spans hundreds of acres and includes multiple distinct attractions rather than being a single-point attraction.
